description: This Java source file contains the implementation of the ProductAttributeDao interface, providing database access methods for ProductAttribute entities in a product catalog system. It uses QueryDSL for building type-safe database queries and extends a generic DAO implementation.

classes.name: ProductAttributeDaoImpl
classes.description: Implements data access methods for ProductAttribute entities, utilizing QueryDSL for constructing type-safe JPQL queries and extending a generic DAO class.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a ProductAttribute entity by its ID, joining related entities to fetch associated data.

methods.name: getByOptionId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ProductAttributes associated with a specific product option ID and store.

methods.name: getByAttributeIds
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ProductAttributes matching a list of attribute IDs within a specific store.

methods.name: getByOptionValueId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ProductAttributes associated with a specific product option value ID and store.

methods.name: getByProduct
methods.description: Retrieves all ProductAttributes associated with a specific product, store, and language, fetching related option values and descriptions.
